# See how much churn a price change can absorb.

> Test a SaaS price increase and see the maximum churn your recurring revenue can absorb before the change stops paying off.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/subscription-price-impact/)

- [This calculator vs. Baremetrics](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/subscription-price-impact/vs-baremetrics.html)
